About Calgary

The sunny city of Calgary is situated around the winding Bow River, with mountain views to the west and plains to the east. Banff National Park is a short drive away from the city, offering Calgary year round access to one of Canada's most beautiful outdoor playgrounds - the Canadian Rockies.

This mountain-lined, cosmopolitan city is home to Canada's booming oil and gas industry, often associated with low unemployment rates and high growth. Sometimes referred to as 'Cowtown', the city brings in over a million people each summer to the Calgary Stampede. Significantly, Calgary continuously demonstrates resiliency to recessions and natural disasters, making for proud and hard-working residents.

Calgary's competitive real estate market offers buying and selling opportunities for nature lovers and city dwellers alike. If you're looking for a city that offers the best of both worlds, Calgary is a great place to search for your next home.
